about: D-SINK-109 (2026-11-16, round 2 of the security review): the Sources form's withheld-host predicate over a source URL, shared by the helper's source_host_withheld and Model.sourceHostWithheld (Model.formHostWithheld asks it of the form's typed text). It is R32a's urlHostWithheld / host_withheld (a dotless host, or a non-numeric port, with an `@` after the authority) OR an `@` after the authority's closing `/`, `?` or `#` at all (addressAtAfterAuthority / at_after_authority). Every line that names a source's host in a sentence or a status names `[host withheld]` where it holds; the two printers (shown_source_host, sourceShownHost) differ in case and in an IPv6 literal's brackets, so only the decision is shared. `arms` says which arm holds, for the reader: `rfc` is urlHostWithheld, `at` is the at-after-authority test. Credentials are synthetic.
